summary: The customer wants to investigate using spectroscopy to track protein concentration in a dairy whey stream that transitions between clear and turbid states, using laboratory results as a reference.

facts_stated.text: The dairy process has a whey stream before a concentration stage.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our dairy process includes a relatively clear whey stream before a concentration stage.

facts_stated.text: The stream can become more turbid under certain operating conditions.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions.

facts_stated.text: Laboratory results will be used as a reference.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: with laboratory results used as the reference.

targets.purpose: track protein concentration as the stream changes
targets.enquiry_quote: track protein concentration as the stream changes

process.enquiry_quote: laboratory results used as the reference

customer_premises.claim: Requires a measurement concept that handles turbidity changes rather than assuming a constantly clear liquid.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: We need a first measurement concept that handles this change rather than assuming the liquid always remains clear.

unknowns: Spectroscopic method / wavelength region (e.g., NIR, MIR, UV-Vis)
